ordering: AA before product edits. Candidate runs repeat AA first on the same worker, then AB/BA/AB/BA/AB; keep every observation including invalid/cancelled/error outcomes.
visibility: Visible page, no throttling. Retain visibility transitions and observed frame/long-task vectors. Hidden behavior is a separate correctness/lifecycle check; do not infer its latency from these trials.
kernelEndpoint: Exact committed explorerEvidence.compute invocation to resolved complete result including all intervals. Input construction and full fingerprinting are outside that wall and separately timed. No transport/explorer preparation included.
appEndpoint: Fresh context and fake server, fixed 100k-column trade source; first explicit Continuations activation after startup controls become available to busy=false with the intended-grid bootstrap result. Then Measures/Continuations unchanged reopening. Retain native input/ack/application phase times separately from automation call elapsed. No staged point-only endpoint.
warmth: Synthetic in-process bridge, fixed source/cutoff, no external Origo/network service. Fresh page/context per arm; first-use histories absent at activation, unchanged warm reopening holds the result. Server/fixture construction outside interaction endpoint; startup/navigation retained separately. No cache-cold production certificate.
fingerprint: study-tree-sha256@1, 128 records per bounded chunk; all enumerable result fields, every ledger row/case/match/horizon, summaries, thresholds, provenance and uncertainty key/seed/intervals. Exact pre-edit golden required for every kernel observation.

improvement.statistic: Median paired baseline minus candidate complete-result wall, separately for each kernel case and app first/warm endpoint
improvement.noiseFloor: Larger initial and same-worker A/A p95 absolute paired difference, and two median observed frame intervals
improvement.material: Median paired gain exceeds the floor, at least four of five pairs improve, with corresponding demonstrated unnecessary-work/yield reduction and unchanged whole output/input/endpoint
improvement.null: Within-floor, invalid, unsupported, missing/censored endpoint or no demonstrated work reduction remains inconclusive; do not rerun until green or change definitions after candidates

responsiveness: Retain maximum long task and phase/yield/frame distributions, then exercise actual controls/navigation and latest-request cancellation across preparation, cases, summaries and bootstrap. Existing navigation.v4.json input/draw/frame definitions and budgets stay unchanged. Relative shared-CI comparisons do not waive #96 absolute/cumulative acceptance.
boundary: No queue priority/concurrency/API changes, no sample-count/statistical/seed/digest-byte change, no new source cache/worker. Any later choice beyond yielding/summary work needs measured justification and explicit acceptance coverage. Current retained-history freshness is a prerequisite, not evidence of safe cache reuse.
